reuse.prepared_inputs: first-run masks, M1-M3 inputs, reference crops, canny control; verify against INPUTS_PUBLIC.json / MASK_CHECK.json hashes, rebuild only on mismatch

prompt: Two dogs dancing on a reflective floor in the same room: on the right, a large black Labrador Retriever with a broad chest and thick legs; on the left, a slender grey Italian Greyhound. Their reflections on the floor match them. Keep the original motion, timing, room and camera.

M2.inside_mask: source depth (resampled V-001 raw, no new inference)

selection_for_14b.criterion: highest mean casting-wise silhouette IoU vs source

ltx_canny_control.settings: V-001 E1 (1152x640, anchor first frame, distilled two-stage, Union IC-LoRA 1.0)
ltx_canny_control.control: canny only, CannyEdgePreprocessor 92/200, reuse first-run control if hash matches

uma_memory_policy.if_helper_absent: run SAM and VACE 1.3B; skip VACE 14B and LTX canny as SKIPPED_NO_CACHE_HELPER
uma_memory_policy.nvrm_watch: stop on first NV_ERR_NO_MEMORY; ENGINE_STOPPED_NVRM; no retry

external_gpu_policy.start_condition: 3 consecutive samples with no external GPU compute process and no known external batch parent (e.g. dgx-serving r25_grid)
external_gpu_policy.on_timeout: mark remaining stages BLOCKED_EXTERNAL_GPU, deliver completed stages
external_gpu_policy.if_appears_mid_run: finish current generation, flag CONCURRENT_EXTERNAL_GPU, wait before next stage

slot_keeper.use_if: documented interface usable by other projects
slot_keeper.else: do not use; record findings only

budget.sam_measurements: V-001 E1 x2 + all new outputs

mechanical_fix_preapproval: V-001 amendment 4 rule (geometry/frame multiples, paths, formats); never quality settings
